independent_findings: Query preserver tracks supported-query prefixes only. Unsupported CSI such as overflowed ESC[6 followed after release by nvisible leaves candidate empty and sends orphaned nvisible to renderer; malformed OSC divergence may likewise pass suffix bytes. Preserve bounded VT framing through whole unsupported/malformed frames while answering only exact supported stateless frames.

The overflow query callback has no disposed/PTY-generation guard and its local gate is not invalidated on binding dispose. A late overflow callback can send stale DA1/OSC/pixel replies through a still-connected transport; stale callbacks after discard can also enter dataCallback. Add a disposed/replaced-binding fence and deferred-connect disposal regression.

findings.summary: Recovery with no exact child checks expiry against ambient Date.now even though the authoritative catalog writer uses its injected clock. Clock skew can prematurely refuse a fresh accepted binding; the atomic writer still prevents an expired binding write.
findings.recommended_correction: Use the catalog/store clock for the preflight expiry comparison or delegate expiry exclusively to the atomic writer, and add an offset-clock regression.
